findings.evidence: Candidate 3130c373 changes the visual baseline to reference RO-UI-ACADEMIC-MINIMAL-1.5 and package 68d71bd038158ce38b33d8474f53406ebe88550f84e776d69d32c3ce18c08f21 but preserves referenceApprovalCommit 9f26bd47c653b1c4dd6c3be94c2feefceeb96c4b, whose approval and manifest are v1.4. The actual v1.5 approval-introduction commit is 6ed8e76fb52349780cccac913b3652553a57afbd. approval_lineage_errors and baseline_history_errors reject that inconsistent provenance.
findings.remediation: Bind referenceApprovalCommit to 6ed8e76fb52349780cccac913b3652553a57afbd and prove the full baseline history accepts the exact v1.5 approval lineage.

findings.evidence: Substituting the correct v1.5 approval commit still fails because the authoritative desktop conformance validator accepts only the older amendment/ECR authority shape. Approved v1.5 uses wave_id, slice_id, approved_wave_commit, proposal_commit, and slice_plan, so the current validator reports an invalid authority shape and cannot resolve the approval-record introduction commit. The 34 UI-change gate tests do not exercise this baseline authority lineage.
findings.remediation: Extend the control-only desktop conformance authority validator to authenticate the exact v1.5 wave/slice approval shape while preserving the existing v1.4 amendment/ECR path. Add focused approval-lineage and baseline-history regressions, update the maintenance envelope and evidence, and replay the UI gate suite.
